headline: Nigerian EV Sector Struggles With Commercial Bank Forex Shortages
summary: Electric vehicle manufacturers and importers in Nigeria report difficulties in accessing foreign exchange through commercial banks, raising the import costs for vehicles and equipment.
why: Foreign exchange availability is critical for emerging economies dependent on imported capital goods and raw materials, directly affecting domestic industrial expansion.

impacts.name: Nigerian Electric Vehicles
impacts.why: Limited access to bank foreign exchange increases import costs for vehicles and components.
